cse.name: Computer Science & Engineering
cse.desc: Software, apps, algorithms, and solving problems with code. Great for logical thinkers who love technology.

aids.name: AI & Data Science
aids.desc: Machine learning, data analysis, and building intelligent systems. Perfect for math lovers curious about the future.

ece.name: Electronics & Communication
ece.desc: Circuits, wireless tech, and communication systems. Ideal for those interested in how devices connect and work.

eee.name: Electrical & Electronics
eee.desc: Power systems, motors, and energy solutions. Suited for students interested in electricity and innovation.

mech.name: Mechanical Engineering
mech.desc: Machines, engines, robotics, and manufacturing. Best for hands-on learners who enjoy building and fixing things.

civil.name: Civil Engineering
civil.desc: Buildings, bridges, roads, and infrastructure. Great for those who want to shape the physical world around us.
